activity.role: Head of State and President of the Council of State
activity.notes: Idriss Déby entered N'Djamena after overthrowing Hissène Habré and became Chad's transitional head of state on 2 December 1990. ATLAS separates this short Council-of-State phase from the presidency created under the National Charter on 28 February 1991.

sources.title: Idriss Déby — Encyclopædia Universalis
sources.citation_text: Universalis identifies Idriss Déby as Chad's ruler from 1990 until his death in 2021 after overthrowing Hissène Habré.

sources.title: Idriss Déby
sources.citation_text: The office chronology records Déby as transitional head of state from 2 December 1990 to 28 February 1991 and President of Chad from 28 February 1991 to 20 April 2021.
